overall_assessment: The governed screening workflow demonstrates a methodologically conservative design aligned with Cochrane/Campbell systematic review standards. However, two critical interop failures and silent loss of exclusion evidence during import undermine usability in a real review managed by an information specialist.

findings.description: EPPI-Reviewer export claims compatibility but produces raw JSON serialization of internal ScreeningDecision structs, not the nested study/decision schema that EPPI-Reviewer expects.
findings.recommendation: Implement a true EPPI-Reviewer-compatible JSON structure.

findings.description: Import functions hardcode exclusion_reason.evidence to None and confidence to None for all imported decisions.
findings.recommendation: Preserve evidence excerpts, confidence, and agent_provenance during import.

findings.description: Independent blinding is automatically lifted for all reviewers once a round reaches Consensus or Resolved status.
findings.recommendation: Make unblinding an explicit, policy-governed event.

findings.description: The adjudication_rule is a free-text string validated only for non-emptiness.
CSV header validation uses substring matching rather than exact field-name comparison.
findings.recommendation: Replace substring checks with exact header parsing.

findings.description: PRISMA flow counts and screening decisions are maintained as separate canonical states with no automated derivation.
findings.recommendation: Provide a deterministic, opt-in derivation path from ScreeningBoard to PrismaFlow.

findings.description: Workflow correctly enforces HumanOnly authority for PressReview and FullTextScreening stages.
findings.recommendation: No action required; preserve these invariants.

findings.description: Role enforcement preserves adjudicator independence from original reviewers.

calibration_notes: Information specialists will broadly agree on the criticality of the EPPI-Reviewer and evidence-loss findings. The blinding default will generate the most disagreement.
